$comment: [X2.10] tools/list snapshot for 'notion'. Baseline for attach E2E (X2.11) + drift job (X2.24). source=spec-sample-tools. CC0-1.0.

tools.name: move-page
tools.description: Move a page to a different parent page or data source.

tools.name: query-data-source
tools.description: Query a Notion data source (database) with filters and sorts (uses `data_source_id`).

tools.name: retrieve-a-data-source
tools.description: Get the schema and metadata for a data source.

tools.name: retrieve-a-database
tools.description: Get database metadata, including its data-source IDs.

tools.name: retrieve-page-markdown
tools.description: Read a page's full content as token-efficient Markdown.

tools.name: update-page-markdown
tools.description: Edit a page's content with Markdown (`replace_content` or targeted `update_content`).
